standards_and_deliverability.name: DMARCbis (RFC 9989)
standards_and_deliverability.description: Core DMARC standard (Standards Track); obsoletes RFC 7489 and RFC 9091, removes pct/rf/ri, adds t/np/psd. Reporting moved to RFC 9990 (aggregate) and RFC 9991 (failure).

standards_and_deliverability.name: Google Email Sender Guidelines

standards_and_deliverability.name: Google Postmaster Tools
standards_and_deliverability.description: Official dashboard; check current views, metric definitions, and data visibility.

standards_and_deliverability.name: Microsoft high-volume sender requirements announcement

standards_and_deliverability.name: BIMI Group
